description: This Mendeley Data release contains winter indoor and outdoor environmental measurements from a site-specific study of a deeply retrofitted housing complex in Milan. The authors provide two Excel datasets: controlled charging and discharging tests of building thermal mass in an unoccupied flat, and apartment temperatures during two actual multi-day heating interruptions. Both are freely accessible under CC BY 4.0. The measurements can calibrate thermal-storage simulations, demand-side flexibility strategies and assessments of comfort during energy interruptions. They cover a particular renovated complex and winter conditions, so performance does not establish that of unretrofitted stock or summer heat events. Occupancy and heating conditions also differ between experimental and field datasets. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: Indoor environmental datasets in a retrofitted multiapartment building during winter power outages
notes: G4-0297; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
